description: This file defines the SavedNewsScreen widget, a Flutter widget that displays a list of saved news articles. It provides functionalities to view details of a news article and delete saved articles with confirmation dialogs.

classes.name: SavedNewsScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget representing the screen that displays saved news articles with options to view or delete articles.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the saved news screen, displaying either a message when no saved news exists or a list of saved news articles.

methods.name: _open
methods.description: Navigates to the read article screen to display the full article.

methods.name: _confirmDelete
methods.description: Displays a confirmation dialog and deletes the article from saved news if confirmed, then shows a snackbar.
